title: THRA loss selectively suppresses Hr, Adgrb1, and Hcn2 in thalamic glutamatergic neurons
exact_observed_result: Thra perturbation depleted Thra and reduced Hr and Adgrb1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, with Hcn2 and Rogdi at FDR<0.10, while Ncoa1 and Ar perturbations failed to phenocopy the branch in the same thalamic setting.
biological_interpretation: Mature thalamic glutamatergic neurons carry a THRA-dependent receptor-output branch that does not require acute Ncoa1-like coactivator phenocopy and is separate from ligand-dependent steroid receptor silence.

evidence_records.statistics: 388,046 Thra-perturbation DE rows across 23 cell types; sum of group-level matched perturbed cells = 2,070; Thra row present in all 23 cell types; Thra score < 0 in 22/23; median Thra logFC -0.566; median score -3.54; 17/23 nominal p < 0.05; 2/23 FDR < 0.05.
evidence_records.description: Global measured on-target transcript engagement for the Thra perturbation.

evidence_records.statistics: 241 perturbed cells versus 23,679 controls; Hr logFC -0.752, score -6.42, p 1.35e-10, FDR 2.33e-6; Thra logFC -0.555, FDR 0.0202; Adgrb1 logFC -0.205, FDR 0.0202; Hcn2 logFC -0.269, FDR 0.0736; Rogdi logFC 0.258, FDR 0.0980; Scube2 FDR 0.134; Abca2 FDR 0.185.
evidence_records.description: The only Thra cell type with several non-target genes below FDR 0.1.

evidence_records.statistics: Thra perturbation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut had Hr logFC -0.752, FDR 2.329e-6; Thra logFC -0.555, FDR 0.0202; and Adgrb1 logFC -0.205, FDR 0.0202. Thra perturbation in 155 MB Glut had Thra logFC -0.667, FDR 0.00254.
evidence_records.description: The same Perturb-seq result table contains clear thyroid-hormone-receptor perturbation effects in selected cell classes.

evidence_records.statistics: In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Ncoa1 perturbation had Ncoa1 logFC -0.151, p=0.0455, FDR=1; Hr logFC -0.165, p=0.1889, FDR=1; Adgrb1 logFC -0.103, p=0.1594, FDR=1; Thra logFC -0.00485, p=0.960, FDR=1. Score correlations between Ncoa1 and Thra signatures were r=0.017 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and r=0.030 in 155 MB Glut.
evidence_records.description: Ncoa1 knockdown did not reproduce the robust Thra perturbation signature in Thra-responsive classes.

evidence_records.statistics: Ar transcript row present in 22/22 Ar signatures; Ar scores were negative in 19/22 and logFC values were negative in 21/22; all Ar self-row pvals_adj=1.0; nominal Ar lowering occurred in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, logFC -1.235 p=0.0455, 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut, logFC -1.018 p=0.0251, and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, logFC -0.495 p=0.0144.
evidence_records.description: On-target Ar transcript depletion was directionally negative in most cell types but was only nominal in three and never significant after correction.

evidence_records.statistics: In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Ar had n=179 and 0 FDR<0.05 genes; Rora had n=139 and 278 FDR<0.05 genes with minimum FDR 9.68e-18; Nr1d1 had n=205 and 116 genes with minimum FDR 3.33e-25; Esrra had n=275 and 57 genes with minimum FDR 1.56e-09; Thra had n=241 and 3 genes with minimum FDR 2.33e-06; Nr2c2 had n=172 and 3 genes with minimum FDR 7.45e-05.
evidence_records.description: The highest-count Ar cell type was capable of yielding strong nuclear-receptor perturbation signatures for other gene targets.

caveats: The strongest non-target rows beyond Hr and Adgrb1 are q<0.10 rather than q<0.05, and several nominally engaged classes were buffered.

prior_expectation.summary: Prior literature and pathway context were taken from the resolved report references; the observed Perturb-seq signal either refines expected gene function by cell type or marks an exploratory response-state neighbor where noted in caveats.
